item.title: Parole board could receive more authority, ‘reasonable approach’ over revocations
item.description: Bills pending in the Alabama Legislature would give the Alabama Board of Pardons and Parole more decision-making authority over parole revocations and modify the current law that doesn’t require a conviction to send people back to prison.
